pyqgis_plugin.name: Geodata: Ortofoto & höjd (Lantmäteriet)
pyqgis_plugin.description: Search and download orthophotos and elevation data from Lantmäteriet's STAC services, directly from the map
pyqgis_plugin.about: Searches Lantmäteriet's (the Swedish mapping, cadastral and land registration authority) STAC services for orthophotos and elevation data with map-based search, and downloads the selected raster files. Authentication uses QGIS' built-in authentication manager (OAuth2). Covers Sweden only, since it queries a Swedish data provider; requires access keys ordered through Lantmäteriet's Geotorget. The user interface is in Swedish; see the "User interface" section in the README for an English explanation of every dialog and label. Independent plugin, not developed by Lantmäteriet.
